title: Coloring is off,  looks like children’s art class…
text:
Coloring is off, looks like children’s art class…. This is maybe a little off color. When I think of ivory, I think white. This is made in china and feels more like concrete. Not to impressed.

Trust you found this review honest and helpful:-)
